subject: Trouble displaying bootstrap values after changing tip labels

messages.author: ded6b58a5b78d66c
messages.subject: Trouble displaying bootstrap values after changing tip labels
parts:
When I plot my tree without changing the tip labels, it displays the node bootstrap values like normal:

The code:

bs <- bootstrap.pml(aln2.1.pml,bs=100,optNni=TRUE)
mltreeBS <- plotBS(mltree2,bs,type="phylogram", cex=0.5, p=75)
p <- ggtree(mltreeBS) %<+% treedat + xlim(0,0.004)

BUT... when I try to clean it up and change the tip labels and then run the same exact code, the bootstrap values no longer appear.

code:
treedat <- read.csv(file = paste0(analysis_folder, project_name, "_treedata.csv"))
labels2 <- treedat[[5]]
mltree2$tip.label <- labels2

bs <- bootstrap.pml(aln2.1.pml,bs=100,optNni=TRUE)
mltreeBS <- plotBS(mltree2,bs,type="phylogram", cex=0.5, p=75)
p <- ggtree(mltreeBS) %<+% treedat + xlim(0,0.004)

Does anyone know why this would be?
